description: This file provides utility functions for interacting with a Supabase backend, including initializing the client and inserting JSON embedding data into a specified table. It handles environment configuration and batch insertion, with error handling to ensure robustness.

methods.name: Optional["Client"] get_supabase_client()
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Supabase client instance based on environment variables, or returns None if configuration is missing or the library is unavailable.

methods.name: int insert_json_embeddings( client: "Client", table: str, rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], batch_size: int = 200, )
methods.description: Inserts a list of JSON embedding rows into a specified Supabase table in batches, handling errors gracefully and returning the total number of attempted insertions.

ctags.name: insert_json_embeddings
ctags.signature: ( client: "Client", table: str, rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], batch_size: int = 200, )
